messages:
Anna (CS): Hey team — quick week-2 check-in for Cypress Systems private/VPC onboarding. Customer flagged audit-log retention and wants to confirm KMS key rotation window. Can we run through status for networking, IAM, KMS, and enablement docs?
Sam (DevOps): Network done from our side except one subnet ACL rule they want relaxed for their CI runners. I asked for the CIDR.
Maya (Cypress Admin): CIDR is 10.50.128.0/22 — need egress to S3 endpoints and outbound 443 to our monitoring.
Sam (DevOps): Got it. Will add VPC endpoint for s3 and allow 443 outbound for that CIDR. ETA today.
Lila (Security): KMS note — we need their key policy to include our account principal for decrypt during batched restores. Maya, can you confirm they can add `arn:aws:iam::REDDY:role/redwood-inference-access`?
Maya (Cypress Admin): I don't control that KMS account (it's on our security org), but I can open a request. Prefer not to add cross-account roles long-term — can we instead use an external key encryption pattern?
Raj (Solutions): Two options: 1) Cross-account key grant (fast) 2) Envelope encryption where we manage a separate key in their account with explicit grants. If they prefer envelope, we'll provide a KMS terraform snippet and the wrapping flow.
Anna (CS): This ties into renewal risk — they called out compliance pressure for audit retention. If we can't meet their retention policy by next quarter, they may push renewal. Lila, what's the delta between our default audit retention and their ask?
Lila (Security): Redwood default: 30 days in console, 90 days archived (S3). Cypress asked for 1 year immutable retention + SOC2-friendly audit trail. We can extend to 1 year archived if they accept additional storage add-on.
Maya (Cypress Admin): Storage add-on is fine if we get formal SLA on data residency and a runbook for access.
Anna (CS): I'll draft a one-page addendum for the contract team. Raj, can you produce the runbook and sample terraform for KMS + S3 lock by EOD tomorrow?
Raj (Solutions): Yes — will drop a gist and the minimal terraform. Snippet I'll include:
```
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "audit_archive" {
  bucket = "cypress-audit-arch"
  versioning { enabled = true }
  server_side_encryption_configuration { rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" kms_master_key_id = var.kms_key_id } } }
  object_lock_configuration { rule { default_retention { mode = "GOVERNANCE" days = 365 } } }
}
```
Anna (CS): Nice. Also we need to capture their enablement feedback — Maya said their SRE team found the initial docs light on config examples. Raj, can you expand the Private/VPC troubleshooting section with a short checklist?
Raj (Solutions): Will do — network checklist + IAM grant table + KMS patterns + common firewall rules.
deploy-bot: Deployment reminder: `private-onboard/v1.4` docs release scheduled in 2h.
Anna (CS): Action items: 1) Sam to add VPC endpoint + allow CIDR egress (today) 2) Raj to deliver terraform, runbook, and docs updates (tomorrow EOD) 3) Lila to confirm exact retention SLA language and storage pricing (Tue) 4) Anna to draft contract addendum and schedule compliance call with Cypress PM (tomorrow). Will follow up in a short sync at 10:30 PT.
Maya (Cypress Admin): Thanks all — 10:30 PT works. I'll have the KMS request opened and share the ticket.
Anna (CS): Great — ping if blockers. :thumbsup:
